facts.text: Lunar base or pressurized rover: oxygen 30 to 36%, pressure below 85.8 kPa, lunar gravity.
NASA's PSI archive lists 60,866 files (13.47 TB) for 24 combustion investigations (listing of 14 November 2026).

398 of them (104.4 GB, 0.77% of the bytes) carry in their name the NASA identifier or the test number of one of the 26 tests recorded inside these oxygen and pressure ranges: 316 files that are not an archive or a video recording (86.85 MB) and 82 archives and video recordings (104.3 GB).
